raw_response:
I will not buy inorganic fertilizer because it is too costly for my large plot and here in Tabora we mainly grow cassava and some maize intercropped together, which do not need those chemicals. I will use our own saved seed from last season, and we will depend on the rains since we have no way to irrigate nearly six and a half hectares. My family will do most of the work with hand hoes, but I will hire a few people to help with land clearing and weeding when the rains come.
